theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (u φ : Rn n → ℝ) (g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Rn n) (Rn n)), IsOpen U → Integrable u volume → (∃ K, LipschitzWith K φ) → (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x ∧ φ x ≤ 1) → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ U → Chapter02.IsLipschitzTestField g → Chapter02.compactlySupportedSupNorm g ≤ 1 → ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, φ x * u x * Chapter02.euclideanDivergence (g : Rn n → Rn n) x) ≤ Chapter02.bvVariationOn u U + ∫⁻ x, ‖u x‖ₑ * ‖fderiv ℝ φ x‖ₑ
